title: Loss Landscape Geometry of Partial Differential Equation Emulators: Or, Symmetry Learning via Gradient Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2601.20172v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study how neural emulators of partial differential equation solution operators internalize physical symmetries by introducing an influence-based diagnostic that measures the propagation of parameter updates between symmetry-related states, defined as the metric-weighted overlap of loss gradients evaluated along group orbits. This quantity probes the local geometry of the learned loss landscape and goes beyond forward-pass equivariance tests by directly assessing whether learning dynamics couple physically equivalent configurations. Applying our diagnostic to autoregressive fluid flow emulators, we show that orbit-wise gradient coherence provides the mechanism for learning to generalize over symmetry transformations and indicates when training selects a symmetry compatible basin. The result is a novel technique for evaluating if surrogate models have internalized symmetry properties of the known solution operator.

translated_title: 偏微分方程仿真器的损失景观几何：或，通过梯度对齐进行对称性学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.20172v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们通过引入一种基于影响的诊断方法来研究偏微分方程解算器神经仿真器如何内化物理对称性，该方法测量对称相关状态之间参数更新的传播，定义为沿群轨道评估的损失梯度的度量加权重叠。该量探究了学习损失景观的局部几何，并通过直接评估学习动态是否耦合物理等效配置，超越了前向传递等变性测试。将我们的诊断应用于自回归流体流动仿真器，我们表明轨道上的梯度一致性为学习在对称变换上泛化提供了机制，并指示训练何时选择对称兼容的盆地。结果是一种评估代理模型是否已内化已知解算器对称属性的新技术。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于损失梯度重叠的诊断方法，用于评估偏微分方程仿真器是否内化物理对称性，并揭示梯度对齐是实现对称泛化的关键机制。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a diagnostic based on loss gradient overlap to assess whether PDE emulators internalize physical symmetries, revealing that gradient alignment is key for symmetry generalization.
